import tempfile, os
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=".")
os.mkdir(d+"/sub")
w = lambda n, s: open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").write(s)
w("a.conf", "@include b.conf\n"); w("b.conf", "@include a.conf\n")
w("c.conf", "@include nope\n")
w("self.conf", "@include self.conf\n")
w("sub/x.conf", "k = 1\n@include y.conf\n"); w("sub/y.conf", "z = 2\nk = 9\n")
w("top.conf", "k = 0\n@include sub/x.conf\nz = 5\n")
for f in ("a", "c", "self"):
    try: load(f"{d}/{f}.conf")
    except ConfigError as e: print("ConfigError", e)
print(load(f"{d}/top.conf").__dict__)
import shutil; shutil.rmtree(d)
EOF
